assets.prompt: Create ONE production-quality transparent-background 3D cutout asset for the actual iPhone app 小食痰记. Image 1 is the SELECTED FITNESS APP MOCKUP, supplying the intended character's appearance, art direction, colors and physical rubber/clay texture. Images 2 and 3 are the ORIGINAL FIXED full-body and face references of the SAME milk-frog character. Preserve identity precisely. YELLOW pear-shaped soft chubby body and narrow rounded head merging into body, protruding PALE-GREEN eye rings with BLACK pupils, tiny thin straight horizontal deadpan mouth, lighter yellow belly, long floppy arms with original broad hands, short legs and broad frog-like feet. Ugly-cute and slightly mischievous with unchanged deadpan expression. No green frog, no new face, no giant grin, no eyebrows, no nose or snout, no muscular body, no anime or cartoon outline. Treat this as the SAME original 3D character reposed with believable soft studio illumination, warm yellow colors, fine lightly rubbery texture and crisp edges. All pose limbs must be anatomically consistent with the original. Real alpha transparency, including soft contact shadow, without an opaque white or colored canvas, NO text, no speech bubble, no UI, no labels, no border, no typography. Keep character and small props fully visible with ~10% safe transparent margins. Landscape 1536 x 1024 composition, designed to be placed at about 170 x 150 logical px on the yellow fitness hero, readable silhouette at small size. Pose: match the resting milk-frog in the upper-right hero of image 1 very closely. Original frog lying back diagonally on an olive textured fitness mat, belly up, broad feet in the foreground lifted slightly, knees relaxed, long hands resting over belly, a small folded cream towel wrapped loosely on forehead, eyes open looking toward viewer with fixed tiny deadpan mouth. One small olive-cap transparent water bottle beside the mat. Three-quarter view from slightly above. This is the hero character for FitnessView.
